primary_claim: With a small high-variance group and a large low-variance group, Student's t-test rejects a true null far more often than the nominal 5%, while Welch's test stays near 5%.
gap: Prior comparisons report error rates across many conditions; few give a reproducible, interval-based estimate for the common small-treatment, large-control design.
proposed_approach: Monte Carlo simulation with paired comparison of rejection decisions (McNemar) and Wilson intervals.
